rationale: C13 is a highly plausible drafting template. Both orders use the same two-part rationale—Hawaiian land previously reserved by a territorial governor's executive order is no longer needed for a federal military purpose and should be restored to the Territory of Hawaii—followed by a metes-and-bounds description beginning from a survey-referenced point and proceeding through numbered azimuth-and-distance calls. C21 and C20 contain land or boundary descriptions, but lack the distinctive restoration rationale and combined machinery.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS by Executive Order No. 905, dated November 1, 1940, of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii, certain hereinafter-described land ... was reserved for the use of the United States for military purposes
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS by Executive Order No. 174 of the Governor of the Territory of Hawaii, dated December 13, 1924, certain lands ... were set aside for the use of the United States Navy Department
shared_material.explanation: Distinctively parallel opening recitals identify a Hawaiian governor's earlier executive order, the land, and its reservation for a federal military branch.

shared_material.child_excerpt: WHEREAS such land is no longer needed by the United States for military purposes, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that it be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.parent_excerpt: WHEREAS these lands are no longer needed for the use of the Navy Department, and it is deemed advisable and in the public interest that they be restored to the use of the Territory of Hawaii
shared_material.explanation: Near-verbatim operative justification, with only the responsible military entity changed.

shared_material.child_excerpt: Beginning at the west corner ... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey triangulation station "Kawa" ... as shown on Government Survey Registered Map 2669 and running by azimuths
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Beginning at a spike in concrete ... the coordinates of said point of beginning referred to Government Survey Triangulation Station "Halai" ... as shown on Government Survey Registered Map NO. 2539, and running by true azimuths
shared_material.explanation: The same survey-based drafting framework introduces numbered boundary calls, adapted to a different parcel.
